announcements.title: What's New in v1.5.0
bullets: Liked videos — a new switch in the dashboard header opens your Liked list in the same dashboard: channel and topic breakdowns, search, every sort and filter, and export
Remove likes, one at a time or in bulk — on the Liked tab the delete button becomes "Remove likes", with the same confirmation, progress and stop button
Each playlist keeps its own cache and its own sync time, so your Watch Later data is untouched
Filter by how far through a video you got — a slider under Watched with marks at 25 / 50 / 75 / 100, or type any exact number
Fixed: the Watched filter came back empty unless your YouTube was set to English. It works in every language now, and starts working straight away with no re-sync

announcements.title: YouTube Watch Later Tidy v1.5.0 is live — force-update if you don't have it yet
bullets: Open a new tab and go to chrome://extensions
Top-right corner: turn on Developer mode
Reload your YouTube tab — you should now be on v1.5.0 (the version is shown under the dashboard title)
